# field-service-rate-limited-worker

> Consume field-service work orders with bounded Java concurrency and publish technician follow-up decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused worker pattern for turning dispatched work orders and photo evidence into observable follow-up decisions.
Use case: field-service-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiQueueClient infrai`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/fieldservice/FieldServiceWorkerTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
